column1: # Reviewed semantic identities for the homologous GAME/OPEN LIFO memory-allocation subsystem.
# Every row was checked with kf sema addr/disasm --blocks/xref/strings, Ghidra candidates, decoded callers/callees,
# adjacent boundaries, source/history/match state, and FID/vendor controls. Cross-overlay instruction shape and
# a constant 0x4cdc address delta support shared source lineage; no original symbol, TU, or aggregate state struct is claimed.

column8: a0 is live across the malloc call even though Ghidra omits it; Psy-Q MALLOC.H uses signed long size and the result is consumed as a pointer
